svg.title: Figure 3. The Council relationship network
svg.desc: A circle of author names grouped by current: philosophy, Hermetic and Renaissance philosophy, natural magic and astrology, Qabalah, Rosicrucian and alchemical writers, Masonic writers, ceremonial magicians, comparative esotericists and Tarot authors. Inner Council authors have filled markers, Outer Council authors open markers. Lines connect authors with documented relationships, such as Plotinus to Iamblichus, Ficino to Agrippa, Agrippa to Dee, Lévi to Pike, Crowley to Regardie and Regardie to the Ciceros.
svg.text: Filled: Inner Council · Open: Outer Council
GRECO ARCANA · THE SOLITARY STUDY · ORIGINAL EDUCATIONAL DIAGRAM
